description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Irenicus's Vile Duplication twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Irenicus's Vile Duplication spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.name: Echo Mage
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher
